title: feat: add video input to inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl (quest #15318)
author: SvirepyiBambr
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15318

Adds video input to the paid-only `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl` Text API model.

### What changed
- `shared/schemas/openai.ts` — accepts `video_url` content parts (the video content format the pinned OpenRouter `deepinfra/fp16` route consumes).
- `shared/registry/text.ts` + `text-parameters.ts` — registers `video` in `inputModalities` and adds a `promptVideoTokens` rate, so provider-reported `video_tokens` are metered accurately.
- `gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/availableModels.ts` + `configs/modelConfigs.ts` — keeps the pinned `deepinfra/fp16` no-fallback OpenRouter route and advertises the modality.
- `gen.pollinations.ai/src/docs/text-generation.md` + `apidocs-recipes.md` — documents the video `content` format.
- Tests: `test/text/ling-video.test.ts` (video_url parsing + registry modality/pricing + pinned no-fallback route), `test/usage-headers.test.ts` (video_tokens → promptVideoTokens mapping, incl. cached+text split), `test/text/utils/modelResolver.test.ts`, plus the price snapshot.

### Verification
`npx vitest run` on the affected suites: 109/109 passed (video parsing, usage mapping, registry pricing, resolver). `biome check` clean on every changed file. Usage is metered from provider-reported `prompt_tokens_details.video_tokens`; no silent fallback is introduced — the route stays pinned to `deepinfra/fp16` with `allow_fallbacks: false`.

Existing text and image input keep working (covered by the new parsing test).

## Maintainer follow-up
- Prices reported `image_tokens` at the prompt rate (same as the qwen3.8-27b pattern): `openaiUsageToUsage` splits them out of text, and unrated usage bills 0

gist.headline: The hive watches clips
gist.blurb: Ling 3.0 Flash VL can now take video alongside text and images. Send it a clip, and the meter counts the video tokens instead of making up folklore.
gist.summary: Added `video_url` content parts to the paid-only `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl` Text API model, with video input advertised on its pinned OpenRouter `deepinfra/fp16` route and provider-reported `video_tokens` metered through `promptVideoTokens`.
gist.impact: Developers can send videos to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl` using the documented content format while retaining existing text and image inputs, with video usage accurately reflected in billing.
